agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: Uniforms for the Museum of Future Debts are brutalist, actuarial, and clinical. Attire emphasizes slender, 7-head-tall silhouettes with sharp geometric lines, utilizing heavy basalt-colored fabrics, frosted glass accessories, and signal red accents to denote rank and liability status. The look is bureaucratic and cold, reflecting a world of probability politics and inescapable obligation.
